summary.text: Mike Tupper is the Democratic candidate for Iowa House of Representatives District 52 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Republican David Blom.
Tupper has worked in law enforcement, and says in a Ballotpedia survey that his priorities include public school funding, affordability and government accountability.

paragraphs.text: Mike Tupper's career experience is in law enforcement.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Tupper's campaign described a 32-year law enforcement career and said he is running to restore community-focused leadership and trust at the Capitol.
Tupper advanced from the Democratic primary on June 2, 2026.
His listed policy priorities are public education funding, affordability issues especially in housing and health care, government accountability and community safety.
